articles.title: Fifa private money plan had to be scrapped - Wenger
articles.summary: Fifa's chief of global football development Arsene Wenger says the decision to scrap the plan to have private investment in Fifa competitions was "absolutely necessary".

articles.title: Liverpool's squad lacks depth: What areas does Iraola needs to strengthen?
articles.summary: Liverpool are short in a number of positions just three weeks out from their Premier League opener and seemingly no closer to bringing in any further additions this summer.
